body: Clinical ink, a global clinical trial technology company has announced investments from Ardan Equity, a private equity firm specializing in healthcare technology, through Ardan Equity Fund I and from GI Partners a leading private investment firm that has partnered with the company since 2020, through GI Partners Fund VI.
